release_name: Live TV v5.1.4 — Fixed Catalog Scrolling, Hardware Wheel Acceleration & Pro Sports UI
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🚀 Fixed Catalog Scrolling: Fixed CSS rule boundary so the channel browser scrolls smoothly across all 2,989 channels via trackpad, mouse wheel, or keyboard
🎯 Native Hardware Wheel & Keyboard Navigation: Added smooth ArrowUp/Down and PageUp/Down keyboard channel scrolling when browsing, and styled an 8px high-visibility custom scrollbar
🏟️ Professional Sports Broadcast UI: Re-engineered live sports cards inspired by Apple TV+ and ESPN with glassmorphic cards, monospaced scoreboards, and sleek left accent lines
👁️ 1-Click Show / Hide Information Toggle: Instant toggle between Compact Mode (minimalist score strips) and Detailed Mode (full telemetry) with persisted preference
✕ 1-Click Section Dismiss & Toolbar Toggle: Easily hide or show the entire Live Sports carousel from the section header (✕) or top tools bar (🔥 Sports)
⚡ Prominent Header Update Icon & Status Pill: Always-visible update badge and 1-click live GitHub version check
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Live TV (Zero-Ad Shield): Zero commercial interruptions across all 2,989 channels
